def compute_logloss(y_true, y_pred):
    """Compute multi-class logarithmic loss"""
    N = len(y_true)
    M = y_pred.shape[1]

    # Handle edge cases
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_clipped = np.clip(np.clip(y_pred, 10**-15, 1 - 10**-15), 0, 1)

    # Normalize rows to sum to 1
    row_sums = y_pred_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1  # Avoid division by zero
    y_pred_normalized = y_pred_clipped / row_sums

    # Compute log loss
    logloss = -np.mean(
        np.log(y_pred_normalized[np.arange(N), y_true])
        + -np.log(1 - y_pred_normalized[np.arange(N), y_true] + 1e-15)
    )
    return logloss
